meta.title: Labels
meta.description: Create and print QR and barcode labels for inventory items.

header.title: Print labels that scan.
header.description: Choose inventory entries or individual stock items and a template to print QR codes, barcodes, text and images in your browser.

selection.title: 1. Select items
selection.description: Selection stays active while you search or change pages.
selection.emptyDescription: Try another name, SKU or location.

setup.title: 2. Choose setup
setup.description: Setups keep the media size, content, and positioning together.
setup.label: Label setup
setup.emptyDescription: A setup defines the paper dimensions and where each label element is printed.

preview.title: Select an item to preview
preview.description: The selected setup controls which details, codes, and images appear.

printer.title: Printing options
printer.description: Choose Shared Office printer to print without a local installation, including away from the office. Use QZ Tray for a directly connected PT-P710BT. For other printers, use the browser print dialog with the correct media size and 100% scale.

designer.canvas: Label canvas. Arrow keys move the selected element by 0.1 mm; hold Shift to move it by 1 mm.
designer.backgroundHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, or SVG up to 2 MB. The file is stored in the setup.
designer.backgroundUnsupported: This image format is not supported.
designer.backgroundTooLarge: The background image must be no larger than 2 MB.
designer.backgroundReadError: The background image could not be read.
designer.qrColorHint: Use strong contrast between the QR code and its background for reliable scanning.
designer.instructions: Drag the selected element, resize it with the corner handle, or enter exact measurements. Arrow keys move it by 0.1 mm; hold Shift for 1 mm.
designer.chooseElement: Choose an element to edit its position and style.
designer.overlap: Move or resize the image so it does not cover the QR code.
designer.previewNote: The preview and printed label use the same positions.

sample.name: Cordless impact driver
sample.longName: Cordless impact driver with an exceptionally long product name and comprehensive accessory set
sample.longLocation: Workshop · Tool storage · Shelf B · Compartment 12 · Rear storage box
sample.subtitle: 18 V · battery + charger

errors.saveSetup: Unable to save the label setup.
errors.deleteSetup: Unable to delete the label setup.
errors.overlapShort: The object image overlaps the QR code. Edit the setup before printing.
errors.overlap: The object image overlaps the QR code in this setup. Open the designer and move or resize one of them before printing.
errors.urlTooLong: This deployment URL is too long for the label QR code. Use a shorter public origin before printing.
errors.missingImages_one: {{examples}} has no object image. Disable the image element or add the missing image before printing.
errors.missingImages_other: {{examples}} have no object image. Disable the image element or add the missing images before printing.
errors.imageRender: One or more object images could not be rendered. Check the preview and try again.
errors.imageLoad: One or more object images failed to load completely. Nothing was printed; check the image files and try again.

units.description: Select devices by ID or serial number. The label shows this identifier; the QR code opens the specific device and its configuration in stock.
units.search: Search serial number, ID or location…
units.empty: No individual stock items have been recorded for this entry.

direct.photoPreset: P-touch · 24 mm white · Photo + large QR
direct.noPrinter: No PT-P710BT is configured. Set up its USB printer queue for QZ Tray on this computer.
direct.connectFirst: Connect QZ Tray and select the PT-P710BT first.
direct.connectionError: Could not connect QZ Tray. Start QZ Tray and allow access. {{detail}}
direct.limit: Select at most 100 labels per print job.
direct.tooLarge: The template is too large. The print area must be at most {{height}} mm high and 996 mm long. Select the P-touch template or adjust your template.
direct.renderError: The label preview could not be fully prepared.
direct.printError: Printing did not finish: {{detail}} Check the printer and queue before retrying; previously submitted labels may already have printed.
direct.help: Print quality: 180 × 360 dpi. Select the actual loaded tape width. The template describes the printed area (up to {{height}} mm high); the printer adds 2 mm at each end and cuts each label. The mechanism produces about 25 mm of leading tape waste before each separate job. QZ Tray must be running on this computer. Approve its access prompt if shown.
direct.sent: Submitted to the local printer queue. Check the printed labels.

queue.title: Prepared labels
queue.description: Collect labels with different templates for the same tape width. Print the series together; the final label is fed out and cut as well.
queue.empty: Select entries and a template, then choose “Prepare labels”. You do not need to connect the printer yet.
queue.session: This print list stays in the current view. Leaving or reloading the page discards it.
queue.added_one: 1 label added to the print list. You can prepare more now.
queue.added_other: {{count}} labels added to the print list. You can prepare more now.
queue.sent: Series submitted to the print queue and list cleared. Please check the output.
queue.summary: {{tape}} mm tape · approximately {{length}} mm of tape including margins and one leading offcut
queue.loadTape: Load {{tape}} mm tape and select that tape width above.
queue.sameTape: All labels in a series must use the same tape width. Print or clear the current list first.
queue.tooLarge: This series is too large. Split it into smaller print lists.
queue.remove: Remove label {{index}}: {{name}} from the print list

text.heading: Label text & copies
text.name: Title
text.subtitle: Subtitle
text.hint: Changes apply only to these labels. Item data stays unchanged.
text.hiddenSubtitle: This template does not show a subtitle. Enable the field in the designer.

shared.help: Print directly through the office PC. This device needs no printer driver or QZ Tray. The tape width is configured on the shared printer.
shared.offlineHelp: The office PC is disconnected. New jobs wait for up to 10 minutes and then expire.
shared.sent: Submitted to the shared print queue. Track progress below.
shared.loadError: Unable to load the shared print queue.
shared.receiptHelp: “Submitted to printer” confirms the Windows spooler accepted the job. Check physical output. Uncertain jobs are never automatically reprinted.
shared.setupHelp: One-time setup on the office PC. The configuration file contains its access key; keep it private and transfer it only to that PC. Disabled printers can no longer collect jobs.
shared.name: Printer name
